Extracted from Lanelet2 lanelet2_maps/res/mapping_example.osm using the
lanelet2 Python bindings (UtmProjector origin 49, 8) and lanelet2.io.write:

- part_a.osm: first 8 lanelets plus the first 3 areas
- part_b.osm: next 8 lanelets
- part_c.osm: the 10 lanelets that reference regulatory elements (8 unique
  regulatory elements are pulled in with them)

These are canonical lanelet2 OSM files, so merge→split is byte-lossless
against them. Some node ids are large (lanelet2-generated inverted/centerline
geometry present after load); they are stable across extractions.
